sources.title: GitHub - mcrao/legal-slm-125M
sources.snippet: ⚡ In-browser runs the model entirely on the visitor's device via transformers.js — an int8 ONNX export (jonam-ai/legal-slm-125m-sft-onnx, ~133MB, cached after first load; the int8 step costs ~38% on held-out perplexity versus fp32, a deliberate size-for-quality trade).

sources.title: SLM-125M · a legal language model trained from scratch
sources.snippet: SLM‑ 125M A 125-million-parameter Llama-style language model, pretrained from random weights on a legal and financial corpus. Give it the start of a sentence and it continues in the legal register.

sources.title: legal-slm-125 · a 125M legal & financial language model
sources.snippet: Fine-tuned on 5,846 grounded legal & financial Q&A pairs, the same 125M model stops rambling and starts answering. It is a separate model, legal-slm-125m-sft ↗, that streams its reply as you watch.
